overview.title: Houston CPA accounting and tax services.
overview.text: Individual and business taxes, self-employment and back taxes, real estate and investment income, S Corporations and payroll filings, sales and use tax, franchise tax, accounting, bookkeeping, QuickBooks setup, fractional CFO support and IRS tax resolution. services.title: Individual Taxes
services.summary: Personal returns prepared and filed start to finish.
services.text: Skyline offers individual income tax advisory services, which allow the clients to get a clear idea about the filing requirements, deductions, credits, and compliance responsibilities.
services.lead: Individual tax preparation is all about getting your personal taxes ready to file. That includes collecting income details, finding tax deductions for individuals, and filling out the right forms. Whether you have one job or several income sources, our personal tax preparation service manages everything from start to finish.
services.imageAlt: A person working through figures on a calculator beside a laptop

covers.title: Complete tax return preparation
covers.text: We handle your tax return from the start. You just need to share your income documents. We will carefully review them to make sure you get every deduction you qualify for.

covers.title: Federal and state tax filing
covers.text: We file your federal and state returns for you, so you don't need to stress over deadlines or forms.

covers.title: Personal tax filing support
covers.text: We answer all your questions throughout the process. No question is too small. We are here to help you understand everything.

covers.title: Tax deductions for individuals
covers.text: We find every deduction that you are allowed to take. This includes mortgage interest, charitable donations, medical expenses, and more.

covers.title: Tax planning for individuals
covers.text: We help with tax planning year-round, so you are better prepared for next year.

services.title: Self-Employment Taxes
services.summary: Estimates, expense tracking and quarterly filings.
services.text: Freelancers and self-employed people get support in estimating their taxes, tracking their expenses, making quarterly filings, and knowing what deductions are allowed.

services.title: Back Taxes
services.summary: Unfiled returns and past-due obligations, brought current.
services.text: Houston CPA Zahra helps you tackle back taxes. You get an understanding of the notices, filing options, and past-due obligations, and can take the necessary compliance steps.
services.lead: If you have unfiled returns, getting current is always the first step. You get guidance to reconstruct your records, prepare the missing returns accurately, and file them in a way that reduces your exposure.

services.title: Real Estate Taxes
services.summary: Property assessment review and informed decisions.
services.text: Zahra's real estate tax consulting offers support in the areas of property assessment review, thorough explanation of the processes, and support of informed decisions about the possibility of tax reductions.
services.lead: Depreciation, rental income, 1031 exchanges and passive activity rules all change what you owe. Zahra Samji works through how each applies to your property.

services.title: Investment Income
services.summary: Dividends, stocks, bonds and capital gains reporting.
services.text: Get support for dividend income reporting that helps you understand the tax rules, documentation requirements, investment implications, and compliance considerations.
services.lead: You get advisory on the treatment of taxes on stocks, bonds, capital gains, investment income, basis reporting, and how taxation may affect your overall financial portfolio.

covers.title: Dividend income
covers.text: Reporting support covering the tax rules, documentation requirements, investment implications and compliance considerations.

covers.title: Stocks and bonds
covers.text: Advisory on capital gains, investment income and basis reporting, and how taxation may affect your overall financial portfolio.

covers.title: Unemployment and disability
covers.text: Support for unemployment and disability tax concerns, including benefits reporting, withholding rules, return adjustments, and compliance awareness for various situations.

services.title: S Corporations

services.text: Consulting for S Corporation tax matters, helping business owners understand structure requirements, compensation rules, and filings under federal and state regulations.
services.lead: S Corporation elections support help you get clarity about the eligibility criteria, tax forms required, deadlines, and long-term implications of filing responsibly.

covers.title: S Corporation tax preparation
covers.text: Structure requirements, compensation rules and filings under federal and state regulations.

covers.title: S Corporation elections
covers.text: Eligibility criteria, the tax forms required, deadlines, and the long-term implications of filing.

services.title: Payroll and State Filings
services.summary: Quarterly payroll, sales and use tax, franchise tax.
services.text: Zahra's quarterly payroll filings help businesses know their reporting duties, withholding requirements, deadlines, and compliance expectations for employment taxes.
services.lead: Meet every federal, state, and local filing deadline accurately, so penalties, notices, and missed obligations never disrupt your business.

covers.title: Quarterly payroll filing
covers.text: Reporting duties, withholding requirements, deadlines, and compliance expectations for employment taxes.

covers.title: Sales and use tax
covers.text: Advisory services covering nexus evaluation, reporting rules, filing guidance, and state-specific obligations.

covers.title: Franchise tax
covers.text: Support for franchise tax issues that involve interpreting rules, assessing their filing needs, meeting deadlines, and being compliant within state jurisdictions.

services.title: Bookkeeping
services.text: Get bookkeeping support for tracking income and expenses, organizing transactions, and keeping your business records up to date for better financial clarity and decision-making.
services.lead: We don't just track your transactions. We make sure that your income, expenses, and accounts are recorded correctly and consistently throughout the year. From the very first steps of working together, our Houston bookkeeping services help you avoid any confusion, reduce errors, and keep you prepared for stress-free tax filings.

covers.title: Accurate transaction recording
covers.text: We record your every source of revenue, including dividend income, to help you prevent errors.

covers.title: Monthly reconciliations
covers.text: We review your bank and credit card accounts regularly to ensure your records match actual activity.

covers.title: Organized financial records
covers.text: We help you maintain clear records that support better financial decisions.

covers.title: Tax-ready books
covers.text: We align your bookkeeping with IRS guidelines and accounting standards, so you are prepared for the tax season.

covers.title: QuickBooks setup
covers.text: Zahra Samji builds a properly configured QuickBooks system around your business so your books are accurate and functional from day one.

services.title: Accounting Services
services.summary: Records, reviews and reporting you can act on.
services.text: Get accounting support that helps you understand your financial reports, maintain accurate records, and meet tax compliance requirements for your Houston-based business.
services.lead: Accounting is about helping you figure out where you stand financially and what to do next. Whether you are self-employed or managing multiple income streams, accurate accounting plays an important role in giving you long-term success.

covers.title: Accurate financial recordkeeping
covers.text: We keep your records organized and up to date so you always have the information you need to make informed decisions.

covers.title: Monthly and quarterly reviews
covers.text: We identify any potential issues early and stay informed about your overall financial health.

covers.title: Tax-ready accounting
covers.text: We ensure that your books meet IRS requirements and help you avoid surprises when tax season arrives.

covers.title: Income and expense tracking
covers.text: We gain a clear view of cash flow and profitability to better manage your finances.

services.title: Fractional CFO
services.summary: Senior financial strategy without a full-time hire.
services.text: Get senior-level financial strategy, forecasting, and cash flow oversight without the full-time executive salary your budget can't justify yet.
services.lead: A fractional CFO is a qualified financial executive who works with your business on a part-time or project basis. You get the expertise of a CFO: cash flow management, financial forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning, without the full-time salary, benefits, and overhead that come with an in-house hire.

covers.title: Cash flow management
covers.text: We monitor cash positions, identify gaps, and help you plan around seasonal fluctuations or growth surges so you're never caught off guard.

covers.title: Financial forecasting and budgeting
covers.text: We build realistic financial models and operating budgets based on your revenue trends, industry benchmarks, and business objectives.

covers.title: Strategic financial planning
covers.text: From expansion decisions to capital investments, we help you evaluate options with accurate financial analysis. Every major move gets a proper financial lens before you commit.

covers.title: KPI tracking and reporting
covers.text: We identify the key performance indicators that actually matter for your business, set up tracking systems, and deliver clean, actionable reports so you always know where you stand.

covers.title: Virtual CFO
covers.text: Everything delivered remotely with the same level of depth and attention you would expect from an in-house hire.

questions.q: Why hire a fractional CFO instead of a full-time CFO?
questions.a: Most small business owners cannot justify a full-time CFO at a $150,000+ salary, and that is before benefits, bonuses and overhead. A fractional CFO gives you experienced strategic oversight at a fraction of that cost.

services.title: IRS Tax Resolution
services.summary: Notices, penalties, agreements and collection status.
services.text: Are you facing IRS notices or back taxes? Get straightforward guidance on your options, obligations, and the right next steps.
services.lead: Tax resolution refers to the process of resolving unpaid taxes, disputed balances, penalties, or compliance issues with the IRS or state tax authorities. It covers everything from understanding what a notice means to negotiating a formal agreement with the IRS to bring your account back into good standing. The right strategy depends on what you owe, why you owe it, your financial situation, and your filing history.

covers.title: IRS notice review and response
covers.text: Not every IRS notice means you owe money. We review what you received, interpret what it means, and help you respond correctly and on time.

covers.title: Back tax filings
covers.text: Guidance to reconstruct your records, prepare the missing returns accurately, and file them in a way that reduces your exposure.

covers.title: Penalty relief
covers.text: The IRS offers several penalty relief programs, including first-time penalty abatement and reasonable cause relief. We evaluate your eligibility and file the appropriate requests.

covers.title: Installment agreement negotiation
covers.text: If you owe taxes you can't pay in full, an installment agreement lets you pay over time. We negotiate the terms on your behalf to get you a manageable monthly payment.

covers.title: Offer in compromise
covers.text: In certain situations you may qualify to settle your tax liabilities for less than the full amount owed. Your eligibility will be assessed honestly, and the application will be handled if it's a viable option.

covers.title: Currently not collectible status
covers.text: If your financial situation makes payment truly impossible, the IRS can place your account in a temporarily uncollectible status. We help you qualify and document this properly.

covers.title: State tax matters
covers.text: IRS issues sometimes come alongside Texas Comptroller matters. We address both federal and state obligations.

about.title: A solo tax consulting practice led by a licensed Houston CPA.
text: Skyline Financial Management is a solo tax consulting practice founded by Zahra Samji, a licensed Houston CPA. The firm provides advisory support to property owners, individuals, and small businesses tackling tax assessments, filings, and planning. With a focus on clarity and compliance, Zahra offers personalized guidance rooted in professional experience and a commitment to client understanding.

Skyline Financial Management was established due to Zahra's love for making tax advice easier and friendlier for common taxpayers. She worked for top-tier firms like PwC and Deloitte, was also active in the community, and saw that there was a demand for a solo practitioner who would be able to give personal attention and who would help the clients make informed decisions.
Zahra's vision was to bridge the gap between complex tax regulations and the people affected by them, show integrity, and educate the masses professionally.

faqs.q: What tax services does Skyline Financial Management offer?
faqs.a: Skyline Financial Management provides tax advisory support for individuals and small businesses. Services include individual taxes, self-employment taxes, S Corporation guidance, real estate taxes, quarterly payroll filing, and more. The focus is on helping clients understand their tax responsibilities clearly.

faqs.q: Can Skyline Financial Management help with back taxes or IRS letters?
faqs.a: Definitely. Zahra provides counseling for customers who are facing issues of tax arrears or tax notices. She lends her expertise through document checking, clarifying the following actions, and assisting in the process of making decisions based on the individual's situation, all the while keeping in compliance with the regulations.

faqs.q: Is Skyline Financial Management a CPA firm?
faqs.a: Skyline is owned and operated by a licensed CPA, although it is not a CPA firm and does not perform audit or attestation services. The practice focuses on practical tax consulting and professional insight.

faqs.q: Does Zahra work directly with every client?
faqs.a: Yes. In her practice, Zahra works solo and takes care of each case, offering people one-on-one tax guidance that not only supports them but also makes them feel well-informed about their taxes.

facts.heading: Scope of practice
facts.text: Skyline Financial Management is owned and operated by a licensed CPA. However, it is not a CPA firm and does not provide audit or attestation services.

facts.heading: Our packages
items: Essential Tax Consultation: ideal for addressing a single, pressing tax issue. It's a one-time engagement that helps you find a focused strategy. Zahra analyzes your situation, answers your questions, and delivers a clear, actionable plan to move forward with confidence.

Annual Advisory Package: proactive, year-round support that helps you tackle issues outside of one-time tasks. This package creates an ongoing advisory partnership, which includes strategic mid-year and end-of-year planning sessions.

Premium Consulting Partnership: the most comprehensive solution for clients with complex needs. This high-touch partnership offers quarterly strategic sessions and priority support, with Zahra acting as your exclusive financial advisor for compliance, payroll, and tax planning, among others.
